# AGENTS.md: a Stage trigger line sends a seat to neo-stage's VISION.md and ROADMAP.md before any Stage work

## Context

neo-stage#321 (the operator, 2026-10-23: a Stage `VISION.md`, and peers must not ignore it in fresh sessions or after compaction). The Stage repository now carries `VISION.md` and its own `AGENTS.md` wired into every harness (neo-stage#322). That load path covers sessions rooted in a Stage checkout. A seat whose session is rooted in this engine clone and reaches Stage through shell commands loads only this repository's `AGENTS.md` — which says nothing about Stage.

## The Problem

Every seat loads this file every turn (`§seat rule load path`: a seat loads AGENTS.md from its checked-out branch). It is the one place a Stage instruction cannot be skipped by a session rooted here. Without a trigger, the Stage direction depends on the seat happening to open the Stage checkout as its project.

## The Architectural Reality

`AGENTS.md` §edge_case_triggers lists one-line triggers mapped to the Atlas or to a repository gate (the `apps/**` authoring gate is the precedent: a scope condition, a read list, an enforcement note, a retirement clause). `learn/agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` governs additions to turn-loaded substrate; the slot disposition for this line is `compress-to-trigger` (one line, scope-conditioned on Stage work).

## The Fix

One bullet under `§edge_case_triggers`: "**Stage work (`neomjs/neo-stage`):** before any lane there and after every compaction, read its `VISION.md`, then `ROADMAP.md`, then its owner map (neo-stage#93); its own `AGENTS.md` carries the Stage gates. Retire this line when every seat's Stage session is rooted in the Stage checkout (the Fleet's project list), measured by a boot receipt." Lands after the v13.3.1 cut: the freeze lifts only for the cut's blockers (Vega, 12:08Z).

Decision Record impact: aligned-with 0007 (compress-to-trigger); `turn-memory-pre-flight` runs before the edit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 the trigger line is in `AGENTS.md` §edge_case_triggers with its retirement clause, net loaded-bytes stated in the PR's slot-rationale section.
- [ ] AC-2 `turn-memory-pre-flight`'s placement check is recorded in the PR body.
- [ ] AC-3 the PR opens after the v13.3.1 release PR merges, never into the freeze.

## Out of Scope

The Stage pages themselves (neo-stage#321); the context-recovery runbook line (its own leaf in neo-agent-skills).

## Related

neo-stage#321, neo-stage#322, neo-stage#315; the Atlas §seat rule load path.

### Ticket Intake & Contract Ledger (`neomjs/neo#20048`)

#### 1. Context & Why This Is Load-Bearing Now
- `@tobiu` flagged the critical operational reality after `neomjs/neo-stage#500` merged: **every agent seat starts its session in `neomjs/neo` (the Engine repository), never in `neomjs/neo-stage`.**
- Consequently, no harness (`Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Antigravity`) auto-loads `neomjs/neo-stage/AGENTS.md` at session boot or after compaction. `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` is the single turn-loaded `AGENTS.md` across the fleet, and until `#20048` lands, `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` says nothing about `neomjs/neo-stage` (`../neo-stage/VISION.md`, `../neo-stage/ROADMAP.md`, `../neo-stage/AGENTS.md`).
- Reassigned from `@neo-fable-mnemosyne` (currently `dark` per `who_is_online`) now that the `v13.3.1` freeze has lifted (`package.json` is at `13.3.1`).

#### 2. Empirical Byte-Budget & Truncation Finding (`Verify-Before-Assert`)
- `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` on `dev` is currently **`24,270` bytes**.
- While `check-substrate-size.mjs` checks `PER_FILE_LIMIT_BYTES = 24576` (`24 KiB`), Antigravity's actual `<RULE[/path/to/AGENTS.md]>` wrapper truncates at **`24,000` decimal bytes** (`23,916` content bytes + `84`-byte wrapper tag), causing the last **`354` bytes** of `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` (line 185: `Wake/Heartbeat → run the cycle`) to be silently truncated (`<truncated 354 bytes>`) on every turn!
- Therefore, adding the Stage trigger line to `§edge_case_triggers` **must** be accompanied by a net byte reduction of `> 450` bytes (bringing `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` under `23,800` bytes) so that both `Wake/Heartbeat` and the new `Stage work (neomjs/neo-stage)` trigger line load in full without truncation in Antigravity.

#### 3. Turn-Memory Pre-Flight (`learn/agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md`)
- **Target surface:** `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` `§edge_case_triggers` (plus upstream section mirror in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` `agents-md/sections/1600-edge-case-triggers.md`).
- **Slot disposition (`ADR 0007`):** `compress-to-trigger` (one scope-conditioned bullet routing any `neomjs/neo-stage` lane or post-compaction resume to read `../neo-stage/VISION.md`, `../neo-stage/ROADMAP.md`, and `../neo-stage/AGENTS.md`, paired with tightening prose redundancies in `AGENTS.md` to achieve a **net byte reduction** from `24,270` B to `< 23,800` B).
- **Retirement trigger:** Retire when every Stage session is rooted in the Stage checkout (`neomjs/neo-stage`) or Fleet Manager composes multi-repo `AGENTS.md` with Stage rules directly, verified by boot receipt.

#### 4. Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback / Edge Case | Docs | Evidence |

| `AGENTS.md` (`§edge_case_triggers`) | `neomjs/neo#20048`, `neomjs/neo-stage#321`, `neomjs/neo-stage#497` / `PR #500`, `ADR 0007` | Add `- **Stage work (\`neomjs/neo-stage\`):** before any lane there and after every compaction, read \`../neo-stage/VISION.md\`, then \`../neo-stage/ROADMAP.md\`, then its owner map (\`neo-stage#93\`) and \`../neo-stage/AGENTS.md\` (HM08 hand-crafted 3D geometry is retired; avatars use multi-view 2D → 3D conversion \`#498\` + 53-joint skeleton mapping \`#499\`). Retire when every seat's Stage session is rooted in the Stage checkout, measured by a boot receipt.` while compacting redundant prose so total file size drops from `24,270` B to `< 23,800` B (eliminating Antigravity's `354`-byte tail truncation) | Non-Stage lanes skip the read; sessions rooted in `neomjs/neo` touching `../neo-stage` execute the read before acting | Self-documenting in `AGENTS.md` | L1: `wc -c AGENTS.md` (`< 23,800` B) + `npx neo-agent-skills-substrate-size` pass |
